src: non-structural marker pixels in the 2x2 interiors of framed 4x4 tiles, grouped by color and relative interior subcell
match_cond: markers connect only when they have the same color and the same relative interior subcell
path: straight horizontal or vertical segment on the tile lattice between matching markers that share a tile row or tile column
trajectory: paint that same relative interior subcell of every intervening tile with the marker color
transform: keep separator lines, tile frames, structural interior fill cells, and original markers unchanged
